status: Exploratory recorded-identity inference; not independently adjudicated

protocol.status: Frozen before corrected pilot results; purposive challenge panel, not probability sample of concepts.
protocol.target: Eligible recorded identity conditional on comparable separately identifiable meanings in one source/member/variety/pronunciation/basis scope.

evaluation.validation: Recorded-identity prediction only; independent linguistic adjudication pending.

bayesian_sensitivity.unit: One outcome-blind hashed context per known family/pair; three selection seeds.
bayesian_sensitivity.assumption: Independent exchangeable family draws, accurate labels; unresolved source/contact dependence. Conditional sensitivity, not calibrated linguistic confidence.

nulls.incidence: Whole-concept bijections stratified by POS and complete form-length profile, within scope. Preserve simple incidence degrees. Independent scope permutation is a sensitivity assumption.
nulls.tail: Plus-one empirical only. No tail extrapolation or q-values.
nulls.collision: Controlled synthetic distributions and length-background diagnostics, not inferred homophony/polysemy.

audit.selection: Outcome-stratified hash within each pair. Audit packet, not adjudicated gold.

resource_block.target: Transfer to held-out resource_block conditional on comparable recorded evidence

family.target: Transfer to held-out family conditional on comparable recorded evidence

bayesian_sensitivity.status: Assumption-conditional sensitivity; not calibrated linguistic confidence

incidence_null.status: POS/profile-stratified incidence sensitivity null; independent scopes assumed; not a homophony model

background_collision_sensitivity.target: Cross-field same-token-length cell identities in the known-family native-ID-disjoint pool
background_collision_sensitivity.length: Reported token count; may include tone tokens, not a validated segmental length
background_collision_sensitivity.counterfactual: Independent unigram token draws at fixed lengths, fit on distinct keys per scope; add-.5 observed-vocabulary smoothing; in-sample sensitivity only, not calibrated homophony

caveats: Purpose-selected panel, not worldwide pair distribution
Source/family transfer tasks retain other forms of dependence
Source/contact dependence not resolved by Bayesian context selection
Null is conditional incidence sensitivity, not calibrated homophony or significance
